explanation: I found no single Mathlib declaration that states this result. `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/StdBasis.lean` defines `Matrix.stdBasis` and proves only one lemma about it, `stdBasis_eq_single`. It has no lemma for the coefficients (`repr`) of `stdBasis`, and none for its `dualBasis`. I also grepped all of Mathlib for `Matrix.stdBasis`, `stdBasis_repr`, and `stdBasis` appearing with `dualBasis`. The only matches use the basis in other contexts (Azumaya algebras, `Basis.linearMap`/`Basis.end` in `ToLin.lean`), plus an unrelated number-field lemma. The theorem does follow from the general fact `Module.Basis.dualBasis_apply`, combined with unfolding `Matrix.stdBasis` and simp. But that is the general dual-basis API combined with unfolding a definition, not one declaration that already contains this entry formula.
